cause_quote: The dispatch resolver added `(operatorRunAuthority && !useScopedClient ? undefined : scope?.hasCurrentClientAuthority)`, making recurring meeting calls inherit the join request’s authority check even when they supplied none.
user_saw: The meeting bot joined and greeted participants, then stopped hearing them shortly after the join command returned.
summary: The fix runs recurring browser audio pulls, browser capture cleanup, and Chrome-node bridge commands under the plugin instance’s background context.
reasoning: The parent of #153989 already contained both recurring audio transports, and its in-process dispatcher only checked authority explicitly supplied by those calls, which they did not supply. #153989 added the fallback to the ambient request’s authority, so later audio calls could fail once the CLI disconnected and the join request released its authority. I verified the change in the source and parent diff, but the bundle’s live comparison covers the November fix and its baseline.
